all.name: Issues, pull requests, and merge requests
all.what: GitHub uses #123 for issues and pull requests. GitLab uses #123 for issues and !123 for merge requests. Full links are also detected.
all.on: Hover over a reference to see its information card. Hold Command and click to open the item in the browser. The terminal uses the workspace repository to resolve a reference written as a number.
all.off: The terminal stops showing information cards for these references.
family.webAddresses.name: Ordinary web links
family.webAddresses.what: Clickable web addresses in the terminal that start with http:// or https://.
family.webAddresses.on: Hold Command and click a web address to open it in the browser.
family.webAddresses.off: Ordinary web addresses appear as text.
family.inputImagePreviews.name: Input image previews
family.inputImagePreviews.what: Labels such as [Image #1] refer to images attached to messages in a coding agent chat.
family.inputImagePreviews.on: Hover over an image label in the terminal to see the image.
family.inputImagePreviews.off: Image labels appear as plain text in the terminal.
